sql.value: select ffas.company_name as companyName, ffas.id as accountSetsId, ffas.individual_tax as individualTax, ffas.individual_tax_code as individualTaxCode from fxy_financial_account_sets ffas where exists ( select 1 from fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas where ffuas.user_id = :userId and ffas.id = ffuas.account_sets_id ) and ffas.deactivated is false

select fe.account_sets_id as accountSetsId, count(1) as numEmployee from fxy_financial_employee fe where exists ( select 1 from fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas where ffuas.user_id = :userId and ffuas.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id ) group by fe.account_sets_id

select ffs.account_sets_id as accountSetsId, count(1) as numSalary from fxy_financial_salary ffs where ffs.period = :period and ffs.state = 1 and exists ( select 1 from fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas where ffuas.user_id = :userId and ffuas.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id ) group by ffs.account_sets_id

SELECT fe.account_sets_id AS accountSetsId, 1 AS isExist FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax fe JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets ffas ON fe.account_sets_id = ffas.id JOIN ( SELECT account_sets_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax WHERE period = :period GROUP BY account_sets_id ) m ON m.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id AND m.max_id = fe.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas WHERE ffuas.user_id = :userId AND ffuas.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id ) AND (ffas.individual_tax IS NULL OR ffas.individual_tax = '')

SELECT fe.account_sets_id AS accountSetsId, fe.result AS result, fe.failed_reason AS failedReason, fe.img_name AS imgName, COALESCE(fe.audit_status, 0) AS auditStatus FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax fe JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets ffas ON fe.account_sets_id = ffas.id JOIN ( SELECT account_sets_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax WHERE period = :period GROUP BY account_sets_id ) m ON m.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id AND m.max_id = fe.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas WHERE ffuas.user_id = :userId AND ffuas.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id ) AND (ffas.individual_tax IS NULL OR ffas.individual_tax = '')

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount FROM fxy_financial_account_sets ffas WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas WHERE ffuas.user_id = :userId AND ffas.id = ffuas.account_sets_id ) AND ffas.deactivated IS FALSE AND (ffas.individual_tax IS NULL OR ffas.individual_tax = '')
